title: Magyarország címere és szimbólumai (The National Coat of Arms)
grammar: Heraldic Symbolism, Constitutional Metaphors & Solemn Hymnic Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the Hungarian coat of arms and its two fields.
I can say how many stripes the Árpád stripes have and what tradition says about them.
I can name the three state symbols that the Fundamental Law lists.
I can use the words of this lesson about the coat of arms.
